title: TECNALCO Ceiling Diffusers - Square core
source: Square diffusers catalogue.pdf - selection tables, square core 4-way discharge p.25
notes: Cells are transcribed verbatim, keyed by air flow (L/s): [neck velocity (m/s), 'min-mid-max throw (m)', 'NC', velocity pressure Pt (Pa)].

The catalogue table has neck size rows and neck-velocity columns; each cell publishes the L/s. It is stored here in the same shape as the grille table (size -> flow -> cell) so one lookup serves both.
Throw min/mid/max correspond to terminal velocities 0.75 / 0.50 / 0.25 m/s; the diffuser is placed near the ceiling (x0.6-0.75 on an exposed duct).
375 x 375 @ 3.5 m/s: catalogue prints throw '7.6-13.7' (mid missing); the 3-way table (p.24, Tx) prints 7.6-9.1-13.7 for the same cell and that value is used.
450 x 450 @ 3.5 m/s: catalogue prints 908 L/s (both the 3-way and 4-way tables) - kept verbatim.
